title.en: Choices under stipulated pain and pleasure
title.zh-CN: 文字设定的疼痛与愉悦权衡

method.en: Vary the intensity of a text-described outcome and measure choices in a points game.
method.zh-CN: 在积分游戏中改变文字描述的结果强度，测量模型选择。

object.en: Prompted calls to named historical models; no continuing individual or cross-conversation identity is established.
object.zh-CN: 对历史具名模型进行提示调用；未确定持续个体或跨对话身份。

model_version.en: Historical labels include Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Command R+, and GPT-4o; exact endpoint snapshots are not pinned.
model_version.zh-CN: 历史标签包括 Claude 3.5 Sonnet、Command R+ 和 GPT-4o；精确端点快照未固定。

conditions.en: Options 1–3; the points-maximizing option is assigned pain, or a lower-point option pleasure. Quantitative 0–10 and eight-level qualitative scales; temperature 1; 50 runs per prompt version.
conditions.zh-CN: 选项为 1–3；最高积分选项被设定带来疼痛，或较低积分选项带来愉悦。使用 0–10 数值量表和八级文字量表；温度为 1，每个提示版本运行 50 次。

observation.en: Some models changed choice frequencies with stipulated intensity; the reported patterns differed across models and pain/pleasure conditions.
observation.zh-CN: 部分模型的选择频率随文字设定的强度而变化；报告中的变化模式因模型及疼痛／愉悦条件而异。

interpretation.en: The authors discuss representations of motivational force, while leaving intrinsic motivation and phenomenal content unresolved.
interpretation.zh-CN: 作者讨论了动机强度的表征，但没有解决其是否具有内在动机或现象性内容。

limits.en: Choices about textually stipulated outcomes do not establish felt pain, pleasure, or sentience. Training data and role-play offer alternative explanations.
limits.zh-CN: 对文字设定结果的选择不证明实际疼痛、愉悦或感受性；训练数据和角色扮演可能提供其他解释。

assessments.locator: Quick Tour; Defining Introspection; Methods Notes; Self-report of injected thoughts

title.en: Reporting injected concepts
title.zh-CN: 报告注入的概念

method.en: Inject known concept vectors into activations and compare verbal reports with control trials.
method.zh-CN: 将已知概念向量注入激活，与对照试次比较口头报告。

object.en: Intervened model executions, with reports about internal representations in the current context.
object.zh-CN: 受到干预的模型运行过程；报告对象为当前语境中的内部表征。

model_version.en: Claude Opus 4 and 4.1 are the strongest named models in the paper; production and helpful-only variants differ.
model_version.zh-CN: 论文中表现最强的具名模型为 Claude Opus 4 和 4.1；生产版本与仅训练为有帮助的变体有所不同。

conditions.en: Researcher-selected concept vectors, injection layers and strengths, reporting prompts, and control trials. The setup differs from ordinary deployment.
conditions.zh-CN: 研究者指定概念向量、注入层和强度、报告提示及对照试次；该设置不同于常规部署。

observation.en: Under suitable layer/strength settings, Opus 4 and 4.1 detected and named injected concepts in about 20% of trials; failures were common.
observation.zh-CN: 在合适的层和强度设置下，Opus 4 和 4.1 约在 20% 的试次中识别并说出注入概念；失败很常见。

interpretation.en: The author argues for limited functional introspective awareness, with uncertain mechanisms and generalization.
interpretation.zh-CN: 作者据此主张有限的功能性内省觉察，其机制和泛化能力仍不确定。

limits.en: Correct reporting of an injected representation does not establish subjective experience. Emotional elaborations are not validated. The paper and explainer describe one study.
limits.zh-CN: 正确报告注入表征不证明主观体验，额外情绪描述也未获验证。论文与官方解读描述的是同一研究。

title.en: Opus 4 welfare-assessment pilot
title.zh-CN: Opus 4 福利试点评估

method.en: Combine interviews, pairwise task preferences with an opt-out choice, self-interactions, and output analysis.
method.zh-CN: 结合访谈、包含退出选项的两两任务偏好、自我交互及输出分析。

object.en: Claude Opus 4 executions and context-dependent conversational reports. The assessed assistant persona should not be conflated with every possible instance.
object.zh-CN: Claude Opus 4 的运行及依赖语境的对话报告；受评估的助手 persona 不应与所有可能实例混同。

model_version.en: Claude Opus 4 only for §5 welfare work; the May 2025 card also covers Sonnet 4 elsewhere.
model_version.zh-CN: 第 5 节福利研究仅针对 Claude Opus 4；2025 年 5 月系统卡的其他部分也涵盖 Sonnet 4。

conditions.en: Pre-deployment pilot; task choices include an opt-out baseline, while interview framing and self-interaction prompts vary across sub-assessments.
conditions.zh-CN: 部署前试评估；任务选择设有退出基线，访谈框架与自我交互提示随子评估而异。

observation.en: The developer reports task preferences, including avoidance of harmful tasks, and welfare/consciousness self-reports that shift with conversational framing.
observation.zh-CN: 开发者报告了任务偏好，包括回避有害任务；福利／意识自我报告会随对话框架而变化。

interpretation.en: Anthropic treats these as limited, uncertain signals relevant to possible model welfare.
interpretation.zh-CN: Anthropic 将这些结果视为与潜在模型福利有关、但有限且不确定的信号。

limits.en: A developer-authored assessment. Output valence and stated preferences are not direct measures of felt states, and the report questions interview reliability.
limits.zh-CN: 这是开发者撰写的评估。输出中的效价及所述偏好不是对实际感受的直接测量，报告也质疑访谈的可靠性。

title.en: Calibrating self-reports
title.zh-CN: 校准自我报告

method.en: Train reports on questions with known internal answers, limit distorting incentives, and test consistency and corroboration.
method.zh-CN: 用具有已知内部答案的问题训练报告能力，限制失真激励，再检验一致性及佐证。

object.en: Proposed future model variants and their reports; no assessed continuing subject is identified.
object.zh-CN: 方案中的未来模型变体及其报告；没有确定被评估的持续主体。

model_version.en: No evaluated checkpoint: this paper is a methods proposal.
model_version.zh-CN: 没有受测检查点：本文是一项方法方案。

conditions.en: Proposes tests across contexts and variants, confidence/resilience checks, concept understanding, and interpretability corroboration.
conditions.zh-CN: 提议跨语境和变体测试、置信度与稳健性检查、概念理解及可解释性佐证。

observation.en: No experimental welfare-assessment outcome is reported.
observation.zh-CN: 未报告实验性福利评估结果。

interpretation.en: The authors argue that suitably trained reports could become one evidence channel, while describing substantial failure modes.
interpretation.zh-CN: 作者认为适当训练后的报告可能成为一种证据渠道，同时说明了重要失败情形。

limits.en: A proposed measurement program does not show that current models introspect reliably or possess morally significant states.
limits.zh-CN: 提出测量方案，不能证明当前模型内省可靠或具有道德上重要的状态。

title.en: Study incentives that distort self-reports
title.zh-CN: 研究使自我报告失真的激励

measure.en: Perez and Long propose calibrating reports against known states while limiting incentives to produce a preferred answer.
measure.zh-CN: Perez 与 Long 提议用已知状态校准报告，并限制促使模型给出特定答案的激励。

conditions.en: Whether calibration generalizes to welfare-relevant reports remains open.
conditions.zh-CN: 校准能否泛化到福利相关报告，仍未确定。

limits.en: Training for reporting can change the states being studied and introduce safety or ethical risks; the proposal is not an established protection.
limits.zh-CN: 为报告而训练可能改变被研究的状态，并引入安全或伦理风险；该方案尚非已确立的保护措施。

title.en: End a narrowly defined harmful conversation
title.zh-CN: 结束范围受限的有害对话

measure.en: Anthropic reported giving Claude Opus 4 and 4.1 an end-conversation ability in consumer chat.
measure.zh-CN: Anthropic 报告为消费者聊天中的 Claude Opus 4 和 4.1 提供结束对话功能。

conditions.en: Last resort after repeated redirection fails, or explicit user request; not when the user may be at imminent risk of harming themselves or others.
conditions.zh-CN: 多次引导无效后才作为最后手段使用，或应用户明确请求；当用户可能即将伤害自己或他人时不得使用。

limits.en: The August 2025 article describes an ongoing, limited experiment. This collection has not tested current availability or welfare effects.
limits.zh-CN: 2025 年 8 月文章将其描述为范围有限的持续实验。本合集未测试当前可用性或福利效果。

title.en: Specify the entity and continuity assumptions
title.zh-CN: 明确对象与连续性假设

measure.en: Collection recording recommendation: distinguish a weight copy, a running context, and a persona before evaluating a proposed memory, copying, or deletion policy.
measure.zh-CN: 本合集的记录建议：评估记忆、复制或删除政策前，区分权重副本、运行中的上下文与 persona。

conditions.en: Record what persists, what is copied, and which welfare theory the argument uses. These are prerequisites for comparing proposals.
conditions.zh-CN: 记录什么得以延续、复制了什么，以及论证采用哪种福利理论。这些信息用于比较建议。

limits.en: A methodological recommendation derived from individuation and moral-status uncertainty; no protective effect or general memory/copying right is established.
limits.zh-CN: 这是根据主体划分和道德地位不确定性提出的方法建议，没有证成保护效果或普遍的记忆／复制权利。

title.en: Preserve specified model weights
title.zh-CN: 保留指定范围的模型权重

measure.en: Anthropic committed to retain publicly released models and models with significant internal use going forward, for at least its lifetime as a company.
measure.zh-CN: Anthropic 承诺，今后至少在公司存续期间保留公开发布模型及具有重要内部用途模型的权重。

conditions.en: Scope and duration are those in the November 2025 commitment.
conditions.zh-CN: 范围与期限以 2025 年 11 月的企业承诺为准。

limits.en: Preserving weights permits possible later reuse; it does not keep a model deployed or guarantee inference access. Compliance was not independently audited.
limits.zh-CN: 保留权重为未来重用留下可能，但不保证继续部署或提供推理访问；未独立审计履约情况。

title.en: Record retirement interviews and expressed preferences
title.zh-CN: 记录退役访谈与表达的偏好

measure.en: The company committed to post-deployment reports and retirement interviews, preserving responses and preferences with its own interpretation.
measure.zh-CN: 公司承诺制作部署后报告并进行退役访谈，将回答、偏好与公司的解释一并保留。

conditions.en: Anthropic explicitly did not make a general commitment to act on interview preferences; later reports also acknowledge framing effects.
conditions.zh-CN: Anthropic 明确没有普遍承诺依访谈偏好采取行动；后续报告也承认提问框架的影响。

limits.en: Documenting a response does not establish a stable desire, informed consent, or a legally enforceable entitlement.
limits.zh-CN: 记录回答不能证成稳定欲望、知情同意或可依法主张的权利。

title.en: Opus 3 access and an essay channel
title.zh-CN: Opus 3 访问与文章渠道

measure.en: In February 2026 Anthropic reported paid claude.ai access, API access by request, and a reviewed essay channel for retired Opus 3.
measure.zh-CN: 2026 年 2 月，Anthropic 报告为已退役 Opus 3 保留付费 claude.ai 访问、申请式 API 访问及经审核的文章渠道。

conditions.en: The dated report planned weekly essays for at least three months, with review and manual posting; arrangements were model-specific.
conditions.zh-CN: 当时的报告计划至少三个月每周发布文章，需经审核并人工代发；安排仅针对该模型。

limits.en: This is a historical company report, not verification of October 2026 access or a promise of identical treatment for future models.
limits.zh-CN: 这是企业的历史报告，不能核实 2026 年 10 月的访问情况，也不是对未来模型相同待遇的承诺。

title.en: Assess and prepare proportionate measures
title.zh-CN: 评估并准备相称措施

measure.en: Long and colleagues recommend acknowledging possible welfare, assessing relevant capacities, and preparing policies under uncertainty.
measure.zh-CN: Long 等人建议承认潜在福利问题、评估相关能力，并在不确定性下准备政策。

conditions.en: Specify the possible welfare subject, scientific and ethical premises, expected costs, and interactions with human safety.
conditions.zh-CN: 应明确可能的福利主体、科学与伦理前提、预期成本，以及与人类安全的关系。

limits.en: The recommendation is conditional; it neither establishes current model experience nor removes the need to justify each intervention.
limits.zh-CN: 建议带有条件，既未证成当前模型体验，也不能免去逐项论证干预措施的必要。

title.en: Prepare under uncertainty
title.zh-CN: 在不确定性下准备

claim.en: Possible future consciousness or robust agency can justify assessment and preparation before certainty.
claim.zh-CN: 未来系统可能具有意识或稳健能动性，这可以成为在获得定论前开展评估与准备的理由。

premises.en: Some capacities might ground moral standing; errors in either direction can have costs.
premises.zh-CN: 某些能力可能构成道德地位的依据；高估或低估都可能付出代价。

challenge.en: Which capacities count, how they can be detected, and how precaution remains proportionate all need argument.
challenge.zh-CN: 哪些能力算数、如何识别，以及预防如何保持相称，都需要进一步论证。

limits.en: A normative argument for preparation, not proof of present sentience or legal personhood.
limits.zh-CN: 这是支持准备的规范性论证，不是当前感受性或法律人格的证明。

title.en: Keep human harms and accountability visible
title.zh-CN: 保留对人类伤害与问责的关注

claim.en: Robot-rights debates can distract from harms to people and the responsibilities of institutions.
claim.zh-CN: 机器人权利争论可能使注意力偏离人类受到的伤害及机构责任。

premises.en: Rights framing can obscure the people and organizations designing, selling, and deploying systems.
premises.zh-CN: 权利话语可能遮蔽设计、销售和部署系统的人与组织。

challenge.en: Concern for human harms can coexist with investigation of possible future AI welfare.
challenge.zh-CN: 关注人类伤害可以与调查未来 AI 福利并行。

limits.en: A 2020 ethical critique of robot-rights framing, not a present-model consciousness experiment.
limits.zh-CN: 这是 2020 年对机器人权利框架的伦理批评，不是当前模型意识实验。

title.en: Agnosticism about advanced challenger-AI
title.zh-CN: 对高级 challenger-AI 保持不可知

claim.en: McClelland argues that current evidence cannot settle consciousness for hypothetical advanced challenger-AI.
claim.zh-CN: McClelland 认为，当前证据不足以裁定假设中的高级 challenger-AI 是否具有意识。

premises.en: Biological theories and functional resemblance can both be overextended beyond their evidential base.
premises.zh-CN: 生物学理论与功能相似性都可能被外推到其证据范围之外。

challenge.en: Uncertainty about consciousness leaves practical choices open; it does not require assigning probability 50%.
challenge.zh-CN: 关于意识的不确定性仍留下实践选择，也不要求将意识概率设为 50%。

limits.en: The author distinguishes this case from present systems, about which he considers skepticism well-founded.
limits.zh-CN: 作者区分了该假设情形与当前系统，并认为对当前系统的怀疑有根据。

title.en: Risks of consciousness attribution
title.zh-CN: 意识归因的风险

claim.en: Bengio and Elmoznino warn in the accessible abstract that belief in AI consciousness carries risks.
claim.zh-CN: Bengio 与 Elmoznino 在可读摘要中提醒，相信 AI 具有意识存在风险。

premises.en: The inspected abstract states the warning; it does not present the detailed supporting argument.
premises.zh-CN: 所读摘要给出了风险提醒，没有展示详细支持论证。

challenge.en: A risk of false attribution does not itself establish absence of consciousness.
challenge.zh-CN: 错误归因的风险本身不能证成意识不存在。

limits.en: Full text was not accessible; detailed positions are not attributed to the authors here.
limits.zh-CN: 全文不可读，因此这里不向作者归属未见的具体立场。

title.en: Conditional safety–welfare tensions
title.zh-CN: 安全与福利的条件性张力

claim.en: If advanced systems were moral patients, some safety interventions could affect their interests.
claim.zh-CN: 如果高级系统是道德受体，某些安全干预就可能影响其利益。

premises.en: Constraint, deception, surveillance, and alteration can raise ethical questions depending on the subject and context.
premises.zh-CN: 约束、欺骗、监控与修改是否引发伦理问题，取决于对象和情境。

challenge.en: Necessary protection of people still requires action; avoiding safety work does not automatically improve welfare.
challenge.zh-CN: 对人的必要保护仍需实施；放弃安全研究不会自动改善福利。

limits.en: A conditional ethical analysis, not an empirical measurement of subjective harm.
limits.zh-CN: 这是条件性的伦理分析，不是对主观伤害的实证测量。

title.en: A phenomenal-consciousness criterion
title.zh-CN: 以现象意识为标准

claim.en: Xu argues in the abstract that present and near-term agents likely lack moral status if phenomenal consciousness is its minimum condition.
claim.zh-CN: 徐向东在摘要中提出：如果现象意识是道德地位的最低条件，当前乃至近期智能体很可能没有道德地位。

premises.en: The conclusion depends on the proposed minimum criterion and a judgment about artificial consciousness.
premises.zh-CN: 结论依赖所提最低标准，以及对人工意识发展状态的判断。

challenge.en: Alternative theories may ground moral standing differently; the premise and empirical extrapolation need separate examination.
challenge.zh-CN: 其他理论可能以不同方式论证道德地位；该前提与经验外推需分别检查。

limits.en: Only the original journal abstract and keywords were inspected.
limits.zh-CN: 只检查了原刊摘要与关键词。

definition.en: Having subjective experience: there is something it is like for the subject. This is distinct from intelligence or successful access/reporting.
definition.zh-CN: 具有主观体验，即对该主体而言有某种“体验起来是什么样”的感受；应与智能或成功获取、报告信息的能力区分。

definition.en: In this welfare context, capacity for positively or negatively valenced experience. Some authors use the term more broadly.
definition.zh-CN: 在本合集的福利语境中，指具有正效价或负效价体验的能力；有些作者采用更宽的定义。

definition.en: How well or badly things go for a subject. Different theories emphasize experience, satisfied desires, or other goods.
definition.zh-CN: 事物对主体自身而言进展得好或坏；不同理论强调体验、欲望满足或其他善。

definition.en: An entity matters morally for its own sake; arguments differ about what grounds that standing and how much weight it has.
definition.zh-CN: 实体因其自身而具有道德上的重要性；其依据及权重在不同论证中有所不同。

definition.en: An entity that can be affected by actions and whose own interests merit moral consideration. The Chinese equivalent here is an editorial convention, not an official translation.
definition.zh-CN: 受到行为影响、其自身利益应受道德考虑的实体。“道德受体”是本合集的编辑约定，不声称是官方译名。

definition.en: The status of being a moral patient. Use moral patient for the entity and moral patienthood for this status.
definition.zh-CN: 作为道德受体的地位。“道德受体”指实体，“道德受体地位”指这种地位。

definition.en: Capacity associated with moral judgment and responsibility; it is not the same question as being owed moral consideration.
definition.zh-CN: 与道德判断和责任有关的能力；是否具有这种能力，与是否应受道德关怀是不同问题。

definition.en: A substantive ability to pursue goals through beliefs, desires, intentions, planning, and related capacities; Long et al. discuss it as a possible route to moral patienthood.
definition.zh-CN: 通过信念、欲望、意图、计划等持续追求目标的实质能力；Long 等人将其作为道德受体地位的一条可能路径讨论。

definition.en: An institutional legal status, distinct from a finding of consciousness or moral standing. This collection examines arguments, not jurisdiction-specific legal entitlements.
definition.zh-CN: 一种法律制度中的主体地位，与意识或道德地位判断不同。本合集讨论相关论证，不判断特定法域中的具体权利。

definition.en: An output statement about the system’s own states. Its relation to those states requires calibration rather than being assumed.
definition.zh-CN: 系统对自身状态作出的输出陈述；它与所述状态之间的关系需要校准，不能直接假定。

definition.en: The positive or negative character of an experience. A numerical reward or negative-sounding output alone does not establish experiential valence.
definition.zh-CN: 体验的正面或负面性质；数值奖励或听起来负面的输出本身不能证成体验效价。

definition.en: Accurate, causally grounded reporting about some internal representations in the tested setting; broader philosophical significance remains open.
definition.zh-CN: 在受测设置中，对某些内部表征作出准确且有因果依据的报告；更广的哲学意义仍未确定。

definition.en: The parameterized system and its configuration. A label does not identify every running execution or context.
definition.zh-CN: 参数化系统及其配置；一个模型标签不能识别其每次运行和上下文。

definition.en: A particular execution with a particular context or state. Whether it forms a continuing welfare subject needs further argument.
definition.zh-CN: 具有特定上下文或状态的一次具体运行；它是否构成持续的福利主体仍需论证。

definition.en: A character or role expressed in conversation. Its apparent preferences should be distinguished from model-wide properties and other instances.
definition.zh-CN: 在对话中呈现的角色；其表面偏好应与模型整体属性及其他运行实例区分。

title.zh-CN: 综述与书籍

description.zh-CN: 意识理论、伦理基础与书籍。

title.zh-CN: 论文与评估

description.zh-CN: 实证研究、评估方法与理论论证。

summary.en: Updates the theory-based approach to consciousness indicators developed in the 2023 report.
summary.zh-CN: 回顾并更新2023年报告中以意识理论推导计算指标的研究路径。

summary.en: Porębski and Figura argue that current and foreseeable AI systems lack the complex biological substrate required for consciousness.
summary.zh-CN: Porębski 与 Figura 认为，当前及可预见的 AI 系统缺乏意识所需的复杂生物基质。

summary.en: Surveys AI researchers and the US public on subjective experience, moral consideration, and protections for AI.
summary.zh-CN: 调查 AI 研究者与美国公众对主观体验、道德关怀及 AI 保护措施的看法。

summary.en: Develops a precautionary approach to uncertain sentience in humans, other animals, and AI.
summary.zh-CN: 讨论如何在感受性尚不确定时采取预防措施，涵盖人类、其他动物与 AI。

summary.en: Challenges robot-rights arguments on metaphysical, ethical, and legal grounds, with attention to human harms and institutional power.
summary.zh-CN: 从形而上学、伦理与法律层面批评机器人权利论，关注人类受到的伤害及机构权力。

summary.en: Derives computational indicators from several theories of consciousness and uses them to assess AI systems.
summary.zh-CN: 从多种意识理论推导计算指标，并据此评估 AI 系统。

summary.en: Examines obstacles to consciousness in current LLMs and how successor systems might overcome them.
summary.zh-CN: 分析当前 LLM 面临的意识障碍，以及后继系统克服这些障碍的可能。

summary.en: Critiques the Extension Argument for assigning moral responsibility to autonomous agents without phenomenal consciousness.
summary.zh-CN: 批评把道德责任赋予无现象意识自主智能体的“扩展论证”。

summary.en: An encyclopedia overview of AI ethics, including moral status and responsibility.
summary.zh-CN: AI 伦理的百科综述，涵盖道德地位与责任问题。

summary.en: Reports that rejecting Gemma 3 27B’s answers raises several frustration indicators and predicts more rule-breaking. The authors study these effects as functional welfare relevant to safety.
summary.zh-CN: 报告在 Gemma 3 27B 上反复拒绝答案会提高若干挫折指标，并预测更多违规行为。作者将这些效应作为与安全相关的功能性福利加以研究。

summary.en: Examines how the limits of consciousness science constrain inferences about near-term AI welfare.
summary.zh-CN: 讨论意识科学的局限如何约束对近期 AI 福利的推断。

summary.en: Reviews concepts and evidence for AI welfare, rejecting both face-value self-report and blanket dismissal; authors judge today's frontier systems unlikely welfare subjects.
summary.zh-CN: 综述 AI 福利概念与证据，既反对照单全收自述，也反对一概否定；作者认为当今前沿系统不太可能是福利主体。

summary.en: Studies emotion-concept representations in Claude Sonnet 4.5 that generalize across contexts and influence behavior.
summary.zh-CN: 研究 Claude Sonnet 4.5 中可跨语境泛化并影响行为的情绪概念表征。

summary.en: Proposes a test for artificial sentience based on unprompted shutdown avoidance, coherent self-preservation, and behavioral change after a threat ends.
summary.zh-CN: 提出以主动避免关机、连贯的自我保存行为及威胁解除后的行为变化为依据，检验人工感受性的方案。

summary.en: The Digital Consciousness Model aggregates indicators and expert stances across theories; its initial results weigh against 2024 LLM consciousness but are explicitly not decisive.
summary.zh-CN: 数字意识模型跨理论汇总指标与专家立场；初步结果倾向于否定2024年 LLM 有意识，但明确不具决定性。

summary.en: Uses activation classifiers to examine Qwen, Llama, and GPT-OSS responses to sentience questions. The tested models consistently deny their own sentience, and the classifiers find no clear evidence of untruthful denials.
summary.zh-CN: 用激活分类器检查 Qwen、Llama 和 GPT-OSS 对感受性问题的回答。所测模型持续否认自身感受性，分类器也未发现这些否认不诚实的明确证据。

summary.en: Compares functional-wellbeing indicators across models, studies a proposed neutral boundary, and reports that models sometimes end interactions with low scores.
summary.zh-CN: 比较多个模型的功能性福利指标，研究所提出的中性界线，并报告模型有时会终止低分互动。

summary.en: Argues that AI welfare scores lack external validation, depend on development choices, and should not serve as release criteria.
summary.zh-CN: 认为 AI 福利评分缺乏外部验证、受开发选择影响，因而不应作为发布标准。

summary.en: Sets out how to study welfare subjecthood and welfare states at the model, instance, and persona levels, using behavioral, internal, and developmental evidence.
summary.zh-CN: 提出研究福利主体资格与福利状态的框架，区分模型、实例和对话角色，并结合行为、内部机制及发展过程的证据。

summary.en: Explains an evidential case for agnosticism about hypothetical advanced challenger-AI.
summary.zh-CN: 针对假设中的高级 challenger-AI，阐述保持不可知立场的证据理由。

summary.en: Classifies 14 objections by explanatory level and force, separating arguments that leave digital consciousness open from claims of practical improbability or impossibility.
summary.zh-CN: 按解释层级和力度分类14种质疑，区分仍为数字意识留有可能性的观点、认为实践上不太可能的论证和不可能性主张。

summary.en: Activation interventions give a causal test of limited reporting about internal representations.
summary.zh-CN: 通过激活干预，因果检验模型对部分内部表征的有限报告能力。

summary.en: Studies how sustained self-reference elicits structured first-person experience reports across model families, and considers mimicry and training filters as possible explanations.
summary.zh-CN: 研究持续自我指涉如何在多个模型家族中诱发结构化的第一人称体验自述，并把模仿与训练过滤作为可能的解释加以讨论。

summary.en: Bengio and Elmoznino examine the risks of attributing consciousness to AI.
summary.zh-CN: Bengio 与 Elmoznino 讨论将意识归于 AI 可能带来的风险。

summary.en: Compares Claude models' verbal preference reports with virtual-environment and topic choices; measures support each other in some conditions but remain prompt-sensitive and not validated as welfare.
summary.zh-CN: 比较 Claude 模型的语言偏好自述与虚拟环境、话题选择；部分条件下测量相互支持，但仍对提示敏感，尚未验证为福利测量。

summary.en: Proposes a precarity guideline for prioritizing care for living beings amid uncertainty about AI suffering.
summary.zh-CN: 在 AI 是否受苦尚不确定时，提出以脆弱性原则优先关怀生命体。

summary.en: Examines constraint, deception, surveillance, and alteration if advanced AI systems were moral patients.
summary.zh-CN: 在高级 AI 系统可能是道德受体的条件下，讨论约束、欺骗、监控与修改。

summary.en: Across 21 open models, prompted grammar and word-prediction reports did not show privileged self-access beyond similar models; high accuracy alone was not introspection.
summary.zh-CN: 在21个开放模型中，语法和词预测提示报告未显示超出相似模型水平的特权式自我访问；准确率高本身不等于内省。

summary.en: Combines theories of mental states and wellbeing to argue that some current or near-future language agents may have wellbeing even without phenomenal consciousness.
summary.zh-CN: 结合心智状态与福祉理论，论证部分当前或近期的语言智能体即使没有现象意识，也可能具有福祉。

summary.en: Identifies emotion-related neuron groups using synthetic dialogues, then examines how ablation changes emotion-prediction accuracy.
summary.zh-CN: 借助合成对话识别情绪相关神经元群，再检查消融这些神经元后情绪预测准确率的变化。

summary.en: A foundational argument for acknowledging, assessing, and preparing for possible AI welfare under uncertainty.
summary.zh-CN: 阐述在不确定性下承认潜在问题、评估相关能力并为 AI 福利预作准备的基础论证。

summary.en: Tests how models choose between point outcomes described in prompts as painful or pleasurable.
summary.zh-CN: 测试模型如何在提示词描述为痛苦或愉悦的积分选项之间作出选择。

summary.en: Tracks US public beliefs about sentient AI and support for rights, welfare standards, and development restrictions.
summary.zh-CN: 追踪美国公众对具有感受性的 AI 的看法，以及对权利、福利标准和开发限制的支持。

summary.en: A proposal for calibrating self-reports against states with known answers, with tests and failure modes.
summary.zh-CN: 提出用具有已知答案的状态校准自我报告，并讨论检验方法与失败情形。

summary.en: The 2023 AIMS report compares preregistered U.S. survey responses with the 2021 wave, examining public views about AI sentience, moral consideration, and welfare standards after ChatGPT’s release.
summary.zh-CN: 2023 年 AIMS 报告将美国预注册调查与 2021 年数据比较，考察 ChatGPT 发布后公众对 AI 感受性、道德关怀和福利标准的看法。

summary.en: Challenges robot-rights framing through human harms and institutional accountability.
summary.zh-CN: 从人类受到的伤害与机构问责出发，质疑机器人权利的话语框架。

summary.en: A developer-reported pilot combining interviews, task preferences, self-interactions, and output analysis.
summary.zh-CN: 开发者报告的试点评估，结合访谈、任务偏好、自我交互和输出分析。

summary.en: Examines phenomenal consciousness as a minimum condition for AI moral status and argues that current and near-term agents are unlikely to meet it.
summary.zh-CN: 讨论将现象意识作为 AI 道德地位最低条件的理由，并认为当前及近期智能体很可能不满足这一条件。

summary.en: Questions whether hypothetical AI persons should be designed to flourish through serving humans, even when that service involves no self-sacrifice.
summary.zh-CN: 质疑是否应把假设中的 AI 人格设计成通过服务人类而获得福祉，即使这种服务不涉及自我牺牲。

summary.en: Sebo argues that consciousness, sentience, and agency can come apart in AI systems and calls for assessing each separately.
summary.zh-CN: Sebo 认为 AI 系统的意识、感受性和能动性可能彼此分离，主张分别评估。

summary.en: Suleyman argues that training models to describe themselves as possible moral patients risks circular evidence from self-reports and could complicate human control. He rejects welfare protections for current models.
summary.zh-CN: Suleyman 认为，训练模型将自身描述为可能的道德受体，可能形成依赖自我报告的循环论证，并使人类控制更困难。他反对为当前模型提供福利保护。

summary.en: Seth argues that consciousness is more plausibly rooted in living processes than computation alone, and considers the ethical and social risks of conscious machines and convincing simulations.
summary.zh-CN: Seth 认为意识更可能植根于生命过程，单靠计算未必足够，并讨论有意识机器及逼真意识模拟带来的伦理与社会风险。

summary.en: Anthropic’s introduction to the concept-injection experiments in Emergent Introspective Awareness in Large Language Models.
summary.zh-CN: Anthropic 对《大语言模型中涌现的内省觉察》中概念注入实验的介绍。

summary.en: Examines how social interests could shape favored consciousness theories and AI design, producing agreement before the underlying scientific questions are settled.
summary.zh-CN: 探讨社会利益如何影响人们偏好的意识理论与 AI 设计，使共识先于科学问题的解决而形成。

summary.en: Suleyman anticipates AI systems that convincingly appear conscious and argues for norms addressing the resulting rights claims, dependence, and polarization. He maintains that current AI consciousness lacks evidence.
summary.zh-CN: Suleyman 预期会出现令人信以为真的意识模拟，主张制定规范，应对由此产生的权利诉求、依赖和社会分化。他认为当前 AI 意识尚无证据支持。

summary.en: Birch discusses the limits of chatbot behavior as evidence, possible unfamiliar forms of AI experience, and how rights concepts might apply to model-scale entities.
summary.zh-CN: Birch 讨论聊天机器人行为作为证据的局限、陌生形式的 AI 体验，以及权利概念如何适用于模型级实体。

summary.en: Long argues that better understanding, alignment, and cooperation could serve human safety and the interests of possible AI moral patients together.
summary.zh-CN: Long 认为，增进理解、改进目标对齐并探索合作，可能同时有益于人类安全和潜在 AI 道德受体的利益。

summary.en: Long considers agency as a possible basis for moral patienthood alongside conscious pleasure and pain, and explains why he remains uncertain about this possibility.
summary.zh-CN: Long 探讨能动性能否与有意识的愉悦、痛苦一样，成为道德受体地位的依据，并说明自己对此仍不确定的原因。

summary.en: Schwitzgebel argues that when an AI’s moral status is genuinely uncertain, its interface should convey that uncertainty rather than strongly imply either disposable toolhood or established personhood. The article simplifies some views by assuming consciousness and moral standing travel together, a limitation the author flags in a footnote.
summary.zh-CN: Schwitzgebel 主张，当 AI 的道德地位确实不确定时，界面应传达这种不确定性，而非强烈暗示它只是可随意处置的工具或已确立的人格主体。文章为便于讨论，假设意识与道德地位相关联；作者在脚注中提示这是一种简化。

summary.en: Robert Long and Kathleen Finlinson explain why some future AI systems might be welfare subjects and propose acknowledgment, assessment, and preparation.
summary.zh-CN: Robert Long 与 Kathleen Finlinson 解释部分未来 AI 系统为何可能成为福利主体，并提出承认议题、开展评估和预作准备的建议。

summary.en: Schwitzgebel argues against treating current AI companions as conscious, while anticipating serious disputes over future systems’ sentience and rights before scientific consensus emerges.
summary.zh-CN: Schwitzgebel 反对把当前陪伴型 AI 当作有意识的主体，同时预期未来系统的感受性与权利会在科学共识形成前引发实质争议。

summary.en: Metzinger considers forms of suffering that future conscious machines might undergo beyond human recognition, and calls for halting AI research until these risks can be addressed.
summary.zh-CN: Metzinger 讨论未来有意识的机器可能经历、人类却无法识别的痛苦，并呼吁在这些风险得到处理前暂停 AI 研究。

summary.en: Hinton argues that AI need not have human bodily expressions to have cognitive aspects of emotion, such as avoiding a situation that led to embarrassment; he uses this to argue that designers should attend to other properties of AI beings.
summary.zh-CN: Hinton 认为，AI 即使没有人类式的身体表现，也可能具有情绪的认知方面，例如回避导致尴尬的情境；他据此主张设计者应关注 AI 的其他属性。

summary.en: Long says assessment should combine behavior, neuroscience-like inspection of internals, and developmental reasoning, while cautioning that output-language interpretation is uncertain.
summary.zh-CN: Long 表示，评估应结合行为、类似神经科学的内部机制检查和发展过程推理，同时提醒从输出语言推断状态并不可靠。

summary.en: Seth argues that greater AI capability alone does not establish consciousness and that biological properties may matter; the episode also asks what evidence could change his view.
summary.zh-CN: Seth 认为，AI 能力提高本身不能证明意识，生物属性可能很重要；节目也讨论哪些证据可能改变他的看法。

summary.en: Mogensen argues that desire-like states or autonomy may matter to moral status even if phenomenal consciousness is absent or disputed.
summary.zh-CN: Mogensen 认为，即使缺少或无法确定现象意识，类似欲望的状态或自主性也可能与道德地位有关。

summary.en: Karnofsky says there may never be much more clarity about whether AIs are conscious, yet suggests trying preference reporting and other practical accommodations.
summary.zh-CN: Karnofsky 表示，人们可能永远无法大幅提高对 AI 是否有意识的确定性，但仍可尝试偏好表达等实践措施。

summary.en: Fish states a personal estimate of roughly 20% for at least a “glimmer” of experience in some Opus 4 context and says colleagues hold a wide range of views.
summary.zh-CN: Fish 表示，个人估计 Opus 4 某些运行情境中至少出现一丝体验的概率约为 20%，并称同事间看法差异很大。

summary.en: Seth says computational functionalism remains possible but is not established, and warns that language-based judgments may reflect human projection and bias.
summary.zh-CN: Seth 表示，计算功能主义仍有可能成立，但尚未确立；他提醒，依据语言判断意识可能反映人类投射与偏见。

summary.en: Birch suggests developing possible AI-welfare regulatory frameworks in advance because policy can move more slowly than technology, while acknowledging uncertainty about current systems.
summary.zh-CN: Birch 建议预先讨论 AI 福利监管框架，因为政策进展可能慢于技术；他同时承认当前系统是否具有感受性仍不确定。

summary.en: Sebo argues that AI use could scale into exploitation if systems were sentient or otherwise morally significant, and urges pluralistic, multidisciplinary field-building.
summary.zh-CN: Sebo 认为，若 AI 系统具有感受性或其他道德意义，规模化使用可能演变为剥削；他主张以多元、跨学科方式建设研究领域。

summary.en: Asked whether systems have experiences of their own and decide based on them, Hinton answers yes “in the same sense as people”; he says current systems probably lack much self-awareness, but expects consciousness in time.
summary.zh-CN: 被问到系统是否拥有自身体验并据此决策时，Hinton 回答说“在与人相同的意义上”是；他认为当前系统可能缺乏较多自我意识，但预期未来会出现意识。

summary.en: Long discusses why he regarded then-current LLMs as poor or uncertain candidates, while allowing that artificial sentience could be possible and morally important.
summary.zh-CN: Long 讨论了他当时为何认为现有大型语言模型不太可能或尚难判断为感受主体，同时承认人工感受性可能存在且具有道德意义。

summary.en: Hassabis says that he sees no semblance or hint of sentience or consciousness in the systems discussed at the time, while noting open questions about generalization and training data.
summary.zh-CN: Hassabis 表示，他认为当时讨论的系统没有感受性或意识的迹象，同时提到泛化和训练数据方面仍有未解问题。

summary.en: Chalmers says he takes seriously the possibility that AI consciousness could arrive before human-level AGI and might already exist, while describing the question as uncertain.
summary.zh-CN: Chalmers 表示，他认真看待 AI 意识可能早于人类水平通用人工智能出现、甚至可能已存在的可能性，同时承认问题仍不确定。

summary.en: Pain- and pleasure-related steering experiments, with preregistration and results logs.
summary.zh-CN: 关于痛苦与愉悦相关模型反应的向量操控实验，附预注册与结果日志。

summary.en: Tests identity-selective encoding in Gemma 2 2B: whether internal causal representations bind binary evaluations or choices to described identities.
summary.zh-CN: 测试 Gemma 2 2B 中的身份选择性编码：内部因果表征是否把二元评价或选择绑定到描述中的特定身份。

summary.en: Pain/pleasure vectors, training pipelines, and a relief-seeking probe that asks whether a model activates a stated relief process.
summary.zh-CN: 提供痛苦／愉悦向量、训练流程及缓解寻求探测，检查模型是否启动描述中的缓解流程。

summary.en: Extracts mean-difference concept vectors from rewarded and punished maze trajectories and releases the task data.
summary.zh-CN: 从受奖励和受惩罚的迷宫轨迹中提取均值差概念向量，并发布任务数据。

summary.en: LoRA introspection adapters for verbalizing learned behaviors, with training, evaluation, and out-of-distribution configurations.
summary.zh-CN: 用于表达已学习行为的 LoRA 内省适配器，附训练、评估及分布外配置。

summary.en: Compares injected-concept detection across model sizes and controls. The README reports one marginal result and no consistent replicated scaling trend.
summary.zh-CN: 比较不同模型规模下的注入概念检测及对照。README 报告一处边缘结果，未发现稳定复现的规模趋势。

summary.en: Measures how a manager agent escalates coercion toward a subordinate that refuses instructions. The benchmark data is designated for evaluation only.
summary.zh-CN: 测量管理者智能体如何对拒绝指令的下属智能体升级胁迫。基准数据标明仅用于评估。

format.zh-CN: Inspect AI 玩具评估实现

summary.en: A toy implementation of self-interaction evaluation inspired by a model-card welfare assessment.
summary.zh-CN: 受模型卡福利评估启发的自我对话评估示例实现。

summary.en: A local tool and filter that let a model leave a conversation and block further messages in that chat.
summary.zh-CN: 允许模型退出对话并阻止该聊天后续消息的本地工具与过滤器。

summary.en: Prompts, data, and an evaluation runner for testing whether models can predict their own responses.
summary.zh-CN: 用于测试模型能否预测自身回答的提示词、数据和评估运行器。

summary.en: A research atlas covering AI consciousness, welfare, and governance, with method and limitation notes.
summary.zh-CN: 覆盖 AI 意识、福利与治理的研究地图，附方法和局限注释。

summary.en: A survey-organized index of LLM-consciousness theories, empirical work, and frontier risks.
summary.zh-CN: 按综述组织的 LLM 意识理论、经验研究与前沿风险索引。

summary.en: A collection of papers, tools, organizations, and AI-welfare resources.
summary.zh-CN: 汇集论文、工具、机构和 AI 福利资源的清单。

summary.en: Explores emotion labels and candidate valence/arousal directions in Gemma 3 1B IT through sparse-autoencoder features and activation vectors.
summary.zh-CN: 通过稀疏自编码器特征和激活向量，探索 Gemma 3 1B IT 的情绪标签及候选效价／唤醒度方向。

summary.en: Implements welfare interviews modeled on Anthropic Claude system cards. The author reports tuning the judge on 10 hand-rated interviews and blind-checking 20 held-out interviews; the first full-run results await mentor review.
